verdict.rationale: Firstbase is an incorporation and back-office platform, so guided legal-document questionnaires are a fair axis for it. The pack never shows a questionnaire that fills in legal documents or flags choices for attorney review. The only pre-fill evidence concerns partner banking and service applications, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer guided questionnaires that fill in legal documents correctly and flag choices that need attorney review
